description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90 with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, begins at a reliability score of approximately 86 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 73 at a cost of 10, with a data point at (4, 78). A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, starts at a reliability score of approximately 82 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 68 at a cost of 10, with a data point at (4, 74). A yellow line, representing “GPT-4”, begins at a reliability score of approximately 75 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 48 at a cost of 10, with a data point at (4, 64). All three lines are solid and do not contain markers.
